question: What is the minimum age to become a member of Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**30 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 84(b)** of the **Indian Constitution** states that the minimum age for a person to qualify for membership of the Rajya Sabha is **30 years**.
 
• The Rajya Sabha, also known as the **Council of States**, is the upper house of the Parliament of India and represents the states and union territories.
 
• Members of the Rajya Sabha are indirectly elected by the elected members of the Legislative Assemblies of States and Union territories, using a system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote.
 
• The Rajya Sabha has a total of **250 seats**, of which **238 members** are elected, and **12 members** are appointed by the President for their expertise in specific fields such as literature, science, art, and social services.
